macros.name: calday
macros.doc: The \calday macro \calday[optional head]{option list} is used to specify a day which is to be printed.

macros.name: calprintclass
macros.doc: The printing of the date and classnumber in each box is done by the commands \calprintdate and \calprintclass.

macros.name: calprintdate
macros.doc: The printing of the date and classnumber in each box is done by the commands \calprintdate and \calprintclass.

macros.name: caltextnext
macros.doc: The command \caltextnext{text} can then be used to print text on successive class days.

macros.name: caltexton
macros.doc: The command \caltexton{class day}{text} specifies a starting day and inserts the indicated text on that day.

macros.name: classday
macros.doc: The macros \classday and \noclassday declare that the specified day is, or is not, a class day.

macros.name: monthname
macros.doc: Print the name of the Month.

macros.name: noclassday
macros.doc: The macros \classday and \noclassday declare that the specified day is, or is not, a class day.

macros.name: skipday
macros.doc: The command \skipday simply advances the date without printing anything in the calendar.

macros.name: weeklytext
macros.doc: The command \weeklytext{text} specifies that the indicated text should appear every week in the box for that day.

envs.name: calendar
envs.doc: The two arguments to the calendar environment are the starting date, in the format m/d/y, and the number of weeks to be printed.
